datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis (January, April, July, October 2012) across Mauritania administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases in different scenarios, georeferenced to administrative boundaries and compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
